paper_title: Limits on new long range nuclear spin-dependent forces set with a K-3He co-magnetometer
notes: Paper constrains pseudoscalar boson (axion-like) coupling to neutrons via spin-dependent forces. Primary limit from Fig. 4: (g_n^p)^2/(4π) < 5.8×10^-10 for massless boson (m → 0). Data points extracted from Fig. 4 curve showing mass-dependent constraints from ~10^-7 meV to ~10^-1 meV. The coupling is presented as (g_n^p)^2/(4π) in dimensionless form. This is a direct laboratory search for anomalous neutron spin-dependent forces using a K-3He co-magnetometer with a 3He spin source at 48.7 cm distance. The experiment also constrains vector boson couplings and other exotic particles (unparticles, Lorentz-violating bosons) but the primary new exclusion limit is on pseudoscalar (axion-like) neutron coupling shown in Fig. 4. Confidence is high because coupling type is unambiguous from abstract and figure, and numerical values are clearly stated in text and figure. | selector: text (sole candidate)
